items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: one time he told Tony Watkins that he should call home

ctx.x: And that was, you know, in later years. And several of the people -- he would tell the singers, whoever they were, in the band, and one time he told Tony Watkins that he should call home and tell his relatives in Philadelphia that he would be on, I think it was the Merv Griffin show -- some television show Duke was doing. And Tony should be sure and wear his tuxedo to the television station because Duke wanted to really put on a nice performance.
So Tony did. He alerted all his relatives. And then he was kept standing in the wings, like you say Ray Nance was. Duke never even acknowledged the fact that he was there and he was never on.
